newsitem.title: USA: Michaels Stores Oct same-store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Michaels Stores Oct same-store sales down.

text.p: Michaels Stores Inc said Wednesday its sales in October decreased to $140.2 million from $140.4 million in the prior year, while same-store sales for the month were down three percent from the prior year.
For the third quarter, which ended October 27, sales increased three percent to $322.2 million from $312.7 million in the third quarter of 1995.

For the first nine months of the 1996 fiscal year, sales increased six percent to $884.6 million from $838.1 million in the prior year. Same-store sales for the first nine months decreased by three percent, it said.
